cases.sentence: Мы же после праздника ___ отплыли из Филипп и через пять дней присоединились к ним в Троаде.
cases.explain: «Пресных хлебов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

cases.sentence: В ___ недели мы собрались вместе для преломления хлеба.
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day, and continued his speech until midnight.

cases.sentence: На окне сидел ___ по имени Евтих.
cases.explain: «молодой человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

cases.sentence: Поскольку Павел долго говорил, Евтих погрузился в ___ и упал на землю с третьего этажа.
cases.explain: «глубокий сон» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

cases.sentence: Поскольку Павел долго говорил, Евтих погрузился в глубокий сон и упал на землю с ___.
cases.explain: «третьего этажа» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

cases.sentence: Павел спустился, лег сверху на ___ и обнял его.
cases.explain: «молодого человека» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

cases.sentence: На рассвете, закончив говорить, Павел отправился в путь, 12 а ___ отвели домой живым, и всех это очень обрадовало.
cases.explain: «молодого человека» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When he had gone up, and had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

cases.sentence: Я знаю, что когда я уйду, к вам придут ___, а они стада не пощадят.
cases.explain: «лютые волки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

cases.sentence: Сейчас я вверяю вас Богу и слову Его благодати, которое может назидать вас и дать вам наследие среди Его ___.
cases.explain: «святого народа» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up, and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
